Definition: from G1002; to heave the lead:--sound.
BiblicalUsage: To sound is the word for heaving the lead, and it appears once, in the shipwreck. In Acts 27:28 they sounded, and found it twenty fathoms, and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms. The lead going down in the dark, measuring the water under a breaking ship.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sounding is a picture of faith in a storm: you cannot see the bottom, so you let down the lead and measure what you can.
